description: Set an owner's optional monthly project budget in microcredits (1000000 = one credit). continue is the default and uses the org pool after the threshold; stop blocks new billable work. null clears the budget and requires continue. Changing it never resets usage or adds credits. Replay the same key after uncertainty; read the budget again for current usage.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: project_budget_set
